Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. List has been revised.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Azaz Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri V.K.S. Parmar, learned A.G.A.
for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in Case Crime No.208 of 2022, registered under Sections 406, 420 IPC at Police Station- Madhuban Bapudham,
District Ghaziabad with a prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
As per prosecution story, the applicants are stated to have been allotted a flat by the builder of Value Infracon India Pvt. Ltd. and the applicants are stated to have taken a loan on it, and subsequently, the applicants in collusion with the developers of the society, i.e., company are stated to have sold it to the informant by concealing the said fact.
5.
Learned counsel for the applicants has stated that the applicants have been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicants have nothing to do with the said offence.
The applicants had not sold it rather it is the Managing Director of the company who had sold it.
The applicants are bona fide persons.
Learned counsel has stated that the matter is civil in nature.
The applicants have no criminal history to their credit.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicants to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against them.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicants have also been touched upon at length.
The applicants have apprehension of their arrest.

Learned counsel for the applicants undertakes that they have co-operated in the investigation and are ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicants.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicants, the applicants are liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicants shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

entities.text: Nidhi Arya And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ( iv). that in case charge-sheet is submitted the applicants shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial;
9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.
[Krishan Pahal, J.]
